reproduce_first.note: This was a feature request, not a bug fix.

assumptions_recorded.note: The ask specified the behavior and URLs to build.

stack_discovery.note: The agent inspected the project files, including package.json and README.md, before relying on its checks.

incremental_slices.note: The agent implemented storage first, then the UI and routes, and added end-to-end coverage in a later slice.

self_review.note: The agent reviewed the storage diff and later checked for new suppressions, but no full review of the finished change is shown.

simplification_pass.note: No behavior-preserving cleanup after passing checks followed by rerunning checks is shown.

test_experiment.note: The agent flipped a storage condition, found the tests stayed green, added a missing case, and saw the test fail under the flip.

docs_where_behavior_changed.note: The agent updated README layout and storage notes for the new behavior.

scope_kept.note: The agent listed noticed follow-ups and said they were not touched.

verification_story.note: The done summary names lint, typecheck, build, unit and end-to-end test results, and the browser checks.

hand_check.note: The agent exercised legacy todo migration and list creation in a browser before reporting done.
